latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — create and export meme videos from your media in seconds.

- Upload images or clips and generate meme videos with AI, no editing software needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG and more, up to 200MB files.
- Simple prompts trigger meme video creation, with Impact font captions and trending sounds for TikTok and social media.
- Download finished 1080p MP4 meme videos, typically in 20-40 seconds per clip.
- Free plan includes 100 credits valid for 7 days without registration.
- All video rendering and editing handled securely on remote GPU servers.
